content: MMO market tracker canonical features (WoW Auctionator PriceTracker, Market Tracker, Market Watcher, TSM; Forza AH tracker): watchlist-scoped scans instead of full market, local snapshot history, min/median/market-value stats, trend views, deal alerts vs reference price, sales/observation log, staleness timestamps. Screen/view-limited tools capture opportunistically when the market window is visible.
